parameters.query: INSERT INTO consultas_esaj (whatsapp_from, whatsapp_phone_number, cpf, current_state, state_updated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('{{ $('Process Input').item.json.from }}', '{{ $('Process Input').item.json.from }}', '00000000000', '{{ $json.new_state }}', NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (whatsapp_from, cpf) DO UPDATE SET current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state, state_updated_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(), email = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.email }}' != '' AND '{{ $json.email }}' != 'undefined' THEN '{{ $json.email }}' ELSE consultas_esaj.email END, verification_code = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.verification_code }}' != '' AND '{{ $json.verification_code }}' != 'undefined' THEN '{{ $json.verification_code }}' ELSE consultas_esaj.verification_code END, code_generated_at = CASE WHEN '{{ $json.verification_code }}' != '' AND '{{ $json.verification_code }}' != 'undefined' THEN NOW() ELSE consultas_esaj.code_generated_at END RETURNING id, '{{ $json.route }}' as route, '{{ $json.response }}' as response, '{{ $json.new_state }}' as new_state
